Describe the change and why it helps.

For graphics changes, include:

- The edited CHR, palette, tilemap or track-shape files.
- Before/after screenshots and the chart, section, speed and emulator tested.
- The build command and checks you ran.

Keep tile slots, file sizes, transparent index 0 and landing centers intact.
See [the graphics guide](../docs/GRAPHICS.md).
Do not include extracted charts, music, game samples, ROMs or build caches.
